Crossed against the archive off and at every placement and count, so the capping of the role-bounded placements is visible rather than hidden.

blocks.explains: Batumi mirrored into four reflected copies - 368 nodes over the same terrain, so size moves and the ground does not. Three-quarters of the resulting pairs fall outside the fitted link budget, so read pairs_beyond_calibration before anything else here, on LITE_FAST, the EU_866 default - a narrower 125 kHz channel that buys sensitivity back at four times LONG_FAST's airtime. Crossed against the archive off and at every placement and count, so the capping of the role-bounded placements is visible rather than hidden.
